name: better-captionkeep
description: Developer tooling for Better CaptionKeep on Chromium browsers.

scripts.build:targets: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/chrome-unpacked dist && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/edge-unpacked dist
scripts.build:chrome-test: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs chrome && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/chrome-unpacked dist
scripts.build:chrome-store: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs chrome-store && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/chrome-store-unpacked dist/chrome-store && node scripts/verify-chrome-store.mjs
scripts.build:edge-test: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs edge && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/edge-unpacked dist
scripts.release:candidate: npm test && npm run lint && npm run security:audit && npm run store:metadata:check && npm run build && npm run build:targets && npm run build:chrome-store && npm run build:intune && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
